ggml_org_rocm_windows.notes: The ggml-org Windows ROCm 10.0 ZIP bundles only ggml-hip.dll, amdhip64_7.dll, rocm_kpack.dll and amd_comgr.dll. hipblas/rocblas/rocsolver and the kernel folders come from a separately installed ROCm runtime. The Adrenalin figure is AMD's ROCm 10.0 matrix for RX 9000; llama.cpp's own release notes do not state a driver minimum.
